level_id_bank.verdict: NOT HELD. VERDICT: THE RECLAIM HAPPENED, THE LID HAS NOT BROKEN. Read 1 asked for a close above B-3.618 (554.49) and got it -- 563.2 on 10-Aug -- so price now sits inside the operator's drawn olive band rather than under it. But the next 2.3-4.0% is the densest overhead on the chart: the channel's own UPPER RAIL (~586 and rising ~1.06/bar) arriving with A-1.886 (578.29) and the weekly EMA36 (581.30). The session high (571.85) stopped inside that band. TRIGGER: a close above the rail AND above 581.30 opens 4.5% of air to the daily EMA200 (612.32). INVALIDATION: back under 554.49 puts price under the reclaimed rung, with the next shelf at 517.66-536.56 and the channel floor (~485 and rising) beneath. CONTEXT: the daily stack is correctly ordered with price above all three, but the WEEKLY is fully inverted (524.08 < 581.30 < 654.84 < 691.95) and the 12M candle is -34.80%. A base that is working, not a trend that has turned -- and the repair level is 23% away.
